title: Weekend Checker Rejects Capitalized Day Names
description:
`is_weekend(day_name)` should return `True` for Saturday or Sunday, regardless of how the day name is capitalized. Right now it only works for all-lowercase input. Find the bug and fix it so every hidden test passes.

**Function signature**
`is_weekend(day_name: str) -> bool`

**Example**
`is_weekend("Saturday")` -> `True`, `is_weekend("Monday")` -> `False`.
